class Box { value = 1; }
function withPrototype(object: object, prototype: object | null) {
  Object.setPrototypeOf(object, prototype);
  return object;
}
const empty = Object.create(null);
const content = Object.assign(Object.create(null), { label: 'prototype', nested: { value: 2 } });
const chain = Object.create(empty);
const throwing = Object.create(null);
Object.defineProperty(throwing, 'constructor', { enumerable: true, get() { throw new Error('constructor getter ran'); } });
console.log(withPrototype(new Box(), empty));
console.log(withPrototype(new Box(), chain));
console.log(withPrototype(new Box(), throwing));
console.log(withPrototype(new Box(), content));
console.log('%o', withPrototype(new Box(), content));
Object.defineProperty(Box, 'name', { value: 'Renamed' });
console.log(withPrototype(new Box(), chain));
const namedPrototype = Object.create(null);
Object.defineProperty(namedPrototype, 'constructor', { value: Box });
console.log(withPrototype({}, namedPrototype));
console.dir(withPrototype(new Box(), chain), { depth: 0 });
console.dir(withPrototype(new Box(), empty), { depth: -1 });
console.log({ a: { b: { c: withPrototype(new Box(), empty), d: withPrototype(new Box(), null) } } });
const shortened = withPrototype(new Box(), null);
console.dir(shortened, { depth: -1 });
console.dir(shortened, { depth: -1, showHidden: true });
console.dir({ shortened }, { depth: 0 });
console.dir({ shortened }, { depth: 0, showHidden: true });
